notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
- Removed Steam DRM
- Savegames will not be encrypted, so users can manual edit the savefile.
- Solved a bug where Level 7 is impossible to complete on Hardcore mode if player dies at the second part of the level.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
- Less delay using the menu (gamepad or keyboard)
- Reduced some dialog text to make the game more fluid
- Added more totems on level 8
- Added more totems on level 9
- Bugfix soapstone online messages.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
- Bugfix: Added delay after get killed, so you don't die twice
- Bugfix: In dark levels, the light now follows player position
- Bugfix: Hardcore achievement is working now
- Bugfix: Level 5 have now 100 gems
- Bugfix: Now Nightmare mode dont apply on Level 10
- Bugfix: Death leaderboard are now working
- New: Button sprites are bigger by 1 pixel
- New: Balanced difficult on Level 4
- New: Balanced difficult on Level 9
- New: Downgrade engine to use OpenGL 2.0 instead 3.0
- New: Particles (blood, water, fire) are now CPU based instead GPU
- New: Level 10 bossfight now have more falling spikes
- New: Remake the last room of level select to show game progress (gems and hearts)
- New: Added a new ending scene and music
- New: Added secret ending when player have all hearts
- New: Added secret ending when player have all gems
- New: Added more fire-lights to make Level 8 and 9 playable at Nightmare mode
- New: Added secret puzzle for those who have completed the game

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]This is an important update[/b]
Previous version of the game had a bug that blocks final level and final boss. It's not possible to end the game on previous versions.

Added new skins to the game 

Update to 1.0.3 as soon as possible

Sorry for the inconvenience

notes.title: Cursed Gem is a pretty charming and amusing challenging platformer out now
notes.notes: I have to admit, Cursed Gem is quite a nice surprise. Throwing in a little comedy into a challenging pixel-art platformer.
